gameDescriptionHtml:
HELLSEED is a first-person horror adventure with puzzles and some action elements.

Italy 1980. Some doctors at a psychiatric hospital in the province of Turin report the disappearance of a colleague to the police. You are the detective investigating what happened. The first place where you start the investigation is the doctor’s house. While in the house, many strange things will happen, and a dark presence will seem to follow you wherever you go. What does it want from you? What is the relationship between it and the doctor? Is the doctor really missing? Is he dead?

All these questions and many others you will have to answer to discover the truth and complete the game. Be careful and don’t panic; someone will try to catch you and take you to hell…

Game Features

  • Realistic graphics – Thanks to the power of S2ENGINE HD the game performs a photorealistic environment that will completely immerse you in the detective’s shoes.
  • Horror atmosphere and Possession system – The game is inspired to the atmosphere of classic italian horror cinematography, with a lot of jumpscares and references to Italian culture. In some parts of the game the distribution of jumpscares is semi-random and a “possession” system will take over the house and hinder the player…
  • Engaging Storyline – As a detective, you’ll uncover the mysteries of the house and its former residents. Through conversations with other characters and interactions with various elements in the environment, you’ll piece together the events that unfolded.
  • Puzzles and investigation – Using a well-structured inventory, during the game you will be able to collect and examine objects and use them when you need to solve puzzles. A clipboard, to be completed during the game, will also help you to understand relationship between characters and the story behind them just like a real detective.
  • Action Gameplay and Quicktime events – Dark presences will start to chase you at a certain point in the game, you have to run and hide using what the environment offers to you. But this isn’t the only gameplay mechanics you will face. The game will offer to you different situations in which you have to use your reflexes in various ways.
  • Gore – The realistic depiction of gore in HELLSEED amplifies the player’s emotional experience, heightening discomfort and stress levels in a way that feels intensely visceral. By exposing the player to the rawness of horror, it creates a gripping atmosphere where tension and fear are constant companions, intensifying the impact of each moment in the game.
